title: Large bridges, impossible waterways, beaches and the perfect house.
content: I have these dreams with the same things, places all the time. The bridge is always packed with cars and traffic, and there is always something going on with the water. Also, I’m driving around looking for a house and find the perfect one. It’s always in the best location, near the water, but the house always has something weird wrong with it. Like it has no yard. I literally have a long dream with all these things every night, or part of it. Like I’ll just find the perfect house. It’s so weird, I can’t help but feel it’s trying to tell me something. Anyone ever think about being hypnotized?
